description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kandawala, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511230 (23/0039)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in the Puttalam District. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, owners, extents, encumbrances, and other land-specific details, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
